scientific_integrity: The all-length independence theorem is proved mathematically; numerical checks are corroboration only. No independent audit or biological experiment has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The bivariate factorial generating polynomial applies when ell <= n <= k+ell.
All-length statements cover independence and covariance, not the full joint law at n>k+ell.
Uniform independent q-ary letters, distinct positive duplication lengths and exactly one tandem duplication are assumed.
Historical-priority checks are not independent or exhaustive.
title: Joint law and independence threshold for two tandem-duplication descendant counts
